question: What do the sages remember about Krishna's deeds?
premises: The sages remember Krishna's divine former deeds
No other is doer of the world
Krishna alone is sustainer, ordainer, and all-pervading Bhava
inference: Arjuna praises Krishna as sole cosmic agent remembered by sages
uncertainties: fused vibhurbhavaśca may be compound or separate terms
plain_english: The sages remember your divine and wondrous former deeds; no other is doer of the world; you alone are sustainer, ordainer, and all-pervading Bhava.
